messages:
maya: Hey team — opened a PR for console/observability: per-route latency heatmap + tracing hook integration. Can someone take a look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/2891

alex: on my list, will review in ~30m. rough glance looks small.

jordan: quick q before i dive in — are we using metric name `route.latency_ms` or `http.route.latency`? affects the Grafana query/widgets.

maya: using `route.latency_ms` (mapped from trace spans in metrics-registry). left a note in the PR description about the mapping.

pri: skimmed the TS changes, left 3 comments about types + one lint nit in the dashboard config. nothing blocking.

alex: found a flaky unit test on CI (metrics-formatter.spec). kicking rebuild.

ci-bot: CI re-run started for pull/2891 (job #4521).

ci-bot: CI passed for pull/2891 (job #4521) :white_check_mark:

jordan: just approved and added a suggestion on the legend formatting (use abbreviated route names). not blocking.

maya: great — thanks all. i'll address pri's nits and the legend suggestion, then merge once CI stays green.

sam: heads up — after merge i need to push the updated Grafana dashboard JSON and adjust alert thresholds for p95. ping me when merged.

maya: merged at 1763006600 — thanks everyone :tada:
